name: ABB Ability System 800xA (DCS with High Integrity SIS)

specifications.basis: ABB Ability System 800xA Safety Overview brochure, copyright © 2025 ABB, PDF read via r.jina.ai (direct WebFetch of application/pdf unsupported): 'The ABB Ability System 800xA High Integrity safety system was released in 2005 and is TÜV certified for SIL 3 operation according to IEC 61508 and IEC 61511.'
ABB System 800xA Safety Overview, © 2025 ABB, read via r.jina.ai: 'The PM857 for up to 128 I/O points and the PM863 and PM867 when larger applications and more I/O is needed.'

ABB System 800xA Safety Overview, © 2025 ABB, read via r.jina.ai: 'ABB has achieved ISASecure System Security Assurance (SSA™) Level 1 certification for System 800xA version according to the IEC 62443 international standard.' (value: ISASecure System Security Assurance (SSA) Level 1 to IEC 62443; 800xA 6.1.1 LTS)
ABB System 800xA Safety Overview, © 2025 ABB, read via r.jina.ai: alarm management 'metrics continuously calculated according EEMUA 191 and ISA 18.2 standards.' (value: EEMUA 191 and ISA 18.2)

ABB System 800xA Safety Overview, © 2025 ABB, read via r.jina.ai: 'certified interference free communications modules for Modbus RS232, Modbus TCP, OPC, Profinet, Profisafe, and other ABB protocols.' (value: Modbus RS232, Modbus TCP, OPC, PROFINET, PROFIsafe)

notes: Product/catalogue record from a page read in the GEG plant WBS sweep.
